answer: Resist sybils by making every identity race the tide alone: at an unpredictable moment the network opens a narrow lagoon channel to the ocean, and each claimant must push a copper token through it by solving a fresh puzzle tied to that exact opening. One operator can watch many channels, but can only steer one token at a time before the tide closes the rest. A thousand names therefore gain no more crossings than a few hands can actually make, while a single genuine agent crosses simply by being present for its own channel.
